{"title":"High-leverage climate policy levers + influence pathways map (with proven wins)","content":"### Plan overview
We will (1) identify the highest-leverage policy/regulatory mechanisms by sector and (2) map realistic influence pathways (who decides, where decisions happen, and how campaigns win), then (3) synthesize into a cross-sector playbook with concrete examples of proven victories.

### Deliverables
- Sector-by-sector list of highest-leverage mechanisms (regulatory + fiscal + market design), with why they are high-leverage and where they have worked
- Influence pathway map: decision-makers, institutions, chokepoints, coalitions, and repeatable campaign models
- Cross-sector synthesis: priority short list, “if you can move only X institutions” guidance, and example case studies tied to each lever
